messages.subject: reactive app
parts:
Hi everybody,


I try to make an app on R Shiny.

The purpuse is : starting with some inputs c(x,y,z)  I want after some treatements and calculs recommand outputs c(a,b) extract from a dataset that I load in ther server.

My probleme is the choice of the reactive fonction to output two variables calculated after a lot of steps.

I tried functions : reactive, reactiveValue , observe, and all of it failed.

Find below my simplified code just for you to understand my problem.

My final objectif is to output the results a and b.


function(input, output){
 
  Base<-read.csv2("Base.csv")
  Base_appart_unique<-read.csv2("Base_appart_unique.csv")
  Base_client_ACP<-read.csv2("Base_client_ACP.csv")
  listing<-read.csv2("ListingTotal.csv")
 
  reactive({
    Appart_1<-input$x
    Appart_2<-input$y
    Appart_3<-input$z
   
    Gilles_step_DF<-data.frame()
    Gilles_step_DF<-subset(Base_appart_unique,appart_ID==Appart_1 | appart_ID==Appart_2 | appart_ID==Appart_3)
    #Gilles_step_DF<-subset(Gilles_step_DF,appart_ID!= "f")
    Gilles_step_DF$X="Gilles"
   
   
    as.data.frame(Indicateurs)
    as.data.frame(Indicateurs_step)
    Indicateurs_step<-aggregate(Gilles_step_DF$prix_quanti,list(client=Gilles_step_DF$X),FUN="mean")
   
   
   
   
   
   
    Base_ACP_Gilles<-Indicateurs
   
    Base_ACP_Gilles1<-round(Base_ACP_Gilles[,c(2:38)], digits=3)
   
    Base_ACP_Gilles<-cbind(Base_ACP_Gilles[,1],Base_ACP_Gilles1)
    Base_ACP_Gilles$no_ligne<-"10257"
    colnames(Base_ACP_Gilles)[1]<-"client"
    #Base_ACP_client2<-Base_ACP_client[,c(2:38)]
    Base_ACP_clientFName<-rbind(Base_ACP_client,Base_ACP_Gilles)
    Base_ACP_clientFinal<-Base_ACP_clientFName[,2:37]
   
   
   
    ACP_Client<-PCA(Base_ACP_clientFinal,ncp=4)
   
   
   
    coord<-as.data.frame(ACP_Client$ind$coord)
   
    coord$no_ligne<-row.names(coord)
    coordonne<-merge(coord,Base_ACP_clientFName[,c(1,39)],by.x="no_ligne",by.y="no_ligne")
   
    etape<-subset(coordonne,coordonne$client=="Gilles")
    Gilles_Dim1<-etape[1,2]
    Gilles_Dim2<-etape[1,3]
    Gilles_Dim3<-etape[1,4]
    Gilles_Dim4<-etape[1,5]
   
    g<-Gilles_Dim1
    h<-Gilles_Dim2
    i<-Gilles_Dim3
    j<-Gilles_Dim4
    coordonne<-as.data.frame(coordonne)
   
    coordonne$dist.dim1<-((coordonne$Dim.1)-g)^2
    coordonne$dist.dim2<-((coordonne$Dim.2)-h)^2
    coordonne$dist.dim3<-((coordonne$Dim.3)-i)^2
    coordonne$dist.dim4<-((coordonne$Dim.4)-j)^2
    coordonne$distance<-(ACP_Client$eig$eigenvalue[1]*coordonne$dist.dim1)+(ACP_Client$eig$eigenvalue[2]*coordonne$dist.dim2)+(ACP_Client$eig$eigenvalue[3]*coordonne$dist.dim3)+(ACP_Client$eig$eigenvalue[4]*coordonne$dist.dim4)
   
   
    distance.croissante<-as.data.frame(sort(coordonne$distance))
    distance.croissante<-arrange(coordonne,distance)
   
    vingt_voisins<-distance.croissante[c(2:21),6]
   
    Appart_reco<-Base[Base$reviewer_id %in% vingt_voisins,1]
    Appart_reco.DF<-as.data.frame(table(Appart_reco))
   
   
   
   
    prix_souhaite=100
   
    Appart_reco.DF<-merge(Appart_reco.DF,Base[,c("appart_ID","prix_quanti")],by.x = "Appart_reco",by.y = "appart_ID",all.x =T )
    Appart_reco.DF<-as.data.frame(unique(Appart_reco.DF))
 
    Appart_reco.DF$Distance<-prix_souhaite-abs(prix_souhaite-Appart_reco.DF$prix_quanti)
    Appart_reco.DF$score<-Appart_reco.DF$Freq*Appart_reco.DF$Distance
    Appart_reco.DF<-arrange(Appart_reco.DF,desc(score))
   
    result_reco1<-as.character(Appart_reco.DF[1,1])
    result_reco2<-as.character(Appart_reco.DF[2,1])
   
    step_result<-as.data.frame(subset(listing,id==result_reco1 |id==result_reco2))
   
    a<-step_result[1,2]
   b<-step_result[2,2]
   
  })
 
  output$reco1<-renderText(a)
  output$reco2<-renderText(b)  
 
}





Thank you very much for your help


Best regards

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: reactive app
parts:
You don't use a reactive expression to *update* variables (and certainly not more than one). Instead, your reactive expression code should *return* an interesting value. Please watch the Effective Reactive Programming videos here, they should clear up a lot of things:
https://www.rstudio.com/resources/webinars/shiny-developer-conference/
